sql:
USE remix_pharmrx;
-- Recorded database observations for API changes and rollback.
SELECT e.phase,j.`id`,j.`status`,j.`stock`,j.`stock_qty`,j.`invoice_id`,j.`net_payable`
FROM rx_demo_evidence e LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(e.details,'$[*]' COLUMNS (
 `id` VARCHAR(150) PATH '$.id',
 `status` VARCHAR(150) PATH '$.status',
 `stock` VARCHAR(150) PATH '$.stock',
 `stock_qty` VARCHAR(150) PATH '$.stock_qty',
 `invoice_id` VARCHAR(150) PATH '$.invoice_id',
 `net_payable` VARCHAR(150) PATH '$.net_payable'
)) j ON TRUE WHERE e.feature='Dispense RX-619' ORDER BY e.id;

name: 12-sql-trigger-blocks
sql:
USE remix_pharmrx;
-- Direct SQL attempts bypassed the API; each was rejected with SQLSTATE 45000.
SELECT feature,phase,
 JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(details,'$.sqlState')) AS sql_state,
 JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(details,'$.message')) AS database_message
FROM rx_demo_evidence
WHERE feature LIKE 'SQL trigger:%' ORDER BY id;

name: 13-final-database-state
sql:
USE remix_pharmrx;
SELECT 'Prescriptions' record_type,COUNT(*) saved FROM rx_prescriptions
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Dispensed',COUNT(*) FROM rx_prescriptions WHERE status='Dispensed'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Invoices',COUNT(*) FROM rx_invoices
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Medicines',COUNT(*) FROM rx_medicines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Patients',COUNT(*) FROM rx_patients
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Safety triggers',COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TRIGGER_NAME LIKE 'rx_safety_invoice_%';

name: 14-savepoint-rollback
sql:
USE remix_pharmrx;
SELECT feature,phase,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(details,'$.changed[0].stock_qty')) changed_stock,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(details,'$.restored[0].stock_qty')) rolled_back_stock FROM rx_demo_evidence WHERE feature='SQL SAVEPOINT';
